mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_placed_outbox (id, order_id, event_id, payload, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{eventId}, #{payload}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, event_id, payload, status, published_at, created_at FROM order_placed_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE order_placed_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
